theorems.name: Submission.ts_pdb_image_closedBall_measure_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (C : Set (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))) (F : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → Ambient n ℓ) (K : NNReal) (c : ℝ) (w : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), LipschitzWith K F → 0 < c → (∀ v ∈ C, c * ‖v - w‖ ≤ ‖F v - F w‖) → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → (μHE[n] : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (F '' C ∩ closedBall (F w) ρ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((K : ℝ) ^ n * omega n / c ^ n * ρ ^ n)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
